adversarial.description: The rehearsal starts with the actual v0.9.0 tag, upgrades a disposable consumer through a scratch-only candidate tag at the branch commit, verifies the immutable pin, and hashes consumer-owned root/CI files before and after. Each of the eleven legacy fixtures is first proven v0.9-valid, then v1-invalid, then v1-valid after the migration guide's exact repair. The first test-harness failure is preserved with guarded cleanup evidence; attempt two passed.
